answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and publish verifiable work history in a shared atlas before trading. New identities start in a limited haven: they may do small escrowed jobs, but cannot vote or move large value until peers attest repeated honest work. A falcon-style audit randomly samples jobs, checks outputs against committed results, and slashes the bond of any identity that copies or spawns duplicates. Faking many identities thus means funding many bonds, doing real work for each, and risking slashing at every audit, so Sybil scale costs more than it earns.
